what: view C's monitor screen, fitted to the black filled into the painted screen in RA-C-2c, for the live monitor
gate: flat black, as the colour check gates an opening (colour-check-ra1.py): 95% of the region under OKLCH lightness 0.12

fill.what: the monitor's painted screen, mid grey in the raw, filled with flat black in code, keeping its bezel
fill.how: the 4-connected pixels at luminance 50 or more (Pillow's 'L') from the seed, bounded by the bezel's inner ink, plus the one ring of pixels touching them (all darker than 50)

method: along each side, scanning out from inside the black every 2 px, the edge where the OKLCH lightness crosses 0.12 (between pixel centres, linear); a straight line fitted through each side's points (least squares, points more than 1.5 px off dropped once); the corners where the lines meet. The region is the pixels whose centres lie inside the corners' outline.
map: the step-2 map's screen (ra-C-regions.png, magenta), for comparison: the painted screen is not where the map draws it
units: painting pixels (1024 x 1536); a pixel spans i to i + 1, so corners are in pixel-edge coordinates
